displayedInputs.question:
Three distinct lines intersect at the same point \(O\). Counting each angle smaller than a straight angle formed by any two noncollinear rays as one angle, how many pairs of vertical angles are there in the figure?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

Point \(A\) lies outside line \(l\), \(AD\perp l\) at point \(D\), and \(AD=5\) cm. Point \(B\) lies on \(l\), and \(AB=7\) cm. What is the distance from point \(A\) to line \(l\), in cm?

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

Lines \(a\) and \(b\) are cut by transversal \(c\). What are angles located between \(a\) and \(b\) and on opposite sides of \(c\) called?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

Given \(AB\parallel CD\), point \(E\) lies between them, \(\angle B=30^\circ\), and \(\angle D=40^\circ\). Find \(\angle BED\). (Here \(\angle B\) denotes \(\angle ABE\), and \(\angle D\) denotes \(\angle CDE\); points \(A\), \(C\), and \(E\) lie on the same side of line \(BD\); unit: degrees; enter only the numerical value.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

Given \(AB\parallel CD\), point \(E\) lies between \(AB\) and \(CD\). Points \(A\) and \(C\) lie on one side of line \(BD\), and point \(E\) lies on the other side (\(B\) and \(D\) lie on \(AB\) and \(CD\), respectively). If \(\angle ABE=130^\circ\) and \(\angle CDE=110^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle BED\) in degrees.

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

Three vertices of rectangle \(ABCD\) are \(A(-1,-1)\), \(B(3,-1)\), and \(C(3,2)\). Let the coordinates of the fourth vertex D be \((a,b)\) and the area of the rectangle be \(S\). Find \(a\), \(b\), and \(S\), in that order (separate your answers with commas).

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(AC=6\) cm, \(BC=8\) cm, and \(AB=10\) cm. \(CD\) is the altitude to hypotenuse \(AB\). Find the length of \(CD\) (unit: cm; a decimal answer is allowed).

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)
Which of the following figures must have line symmetry?
